refs: character design, front view: very broad chest
head shape, ears and face of the sprite to keep
eye style: human-like eye with yellow iris and dark round pupil, half-lidded, sly
desc: Pixel art game sprite of a huge paint goo monster shaped like a Doberman, three-quarter view facing left, standing idle. Head and ears like the head reference sprite: tall pointed ears, simple smooth rounded muzzle with NO detailed nose bridge or realistic dog snout lines, small head on a thick neck. Eyes are human-like: a yellow iris with a dark round pupil, half-lidded, sly smug smirk, drool dripping. The chest is VERY broad and wide, much wider than the shoulders of a normal brute, with big soft round pecs. The whole body looks soft, squishy and melting: smooth rounded glossy blobs instead of sharp muscle lines, very few interior lines, goo sagging and dripping from the arms, chest and chin, lower body melts into a wide glossy pink goo puddle. Glossy hot pink with soft flowing yellow marble streaks. Pixel art, dark outline only on the silhouette, soft shading, big wet highlights.
